Name: MENUPROPERTY_SPEC
Description: Properties shown in menu stat panels. The row ID is the property ID; the row sets its caption, icon, help text, comparison and number format, and how its value is read from params.

Fields.Name: Caption Text ID
Fields.Description: Menu text shown as the property's label.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon shown beside the property. -1: no icon.

Fields.Name: Requirement Property ID
Fields.Description: Likely makes this value a requirement checked against the value of the given property, as in Elden Ring. 0: not a requirement.

Fields.Name: Compare Type
Fields.Description: How the value is judged when two items are compared (higher is better, lower is better, or not compared). Better values are shown in blue, worse in red.

Fields.Name: Format Type
Fields.Description: Number format used to display the value.

Fields.Name: Placeholder Caption
Fields.Description: Temporary caption text used as the label before a Caption Text ID is set.

Fields.Name: Description Text ID
Fields.Description: One-line help text shown for this property.

Fields.Name: Edit Type
Fields.Description: The edit type for this element.

Fields.Name: Slider: Is Looped
Fields.Description: If ON, the slider will loop around.

Fields.Name: Index Reference Parameter ID
Fields.Description: The index reference parameter for this element.

Fields.Name: Overall Operation Type
Fields.Description: The operation to apply after the two extractions. X being extraction value 0, and Y being extraction value 1.

Fields.Name: Slider: Adjustment Value
Fields.Description: The amount the slider will adjust per tick.

Fields.Name: Slider: Minimum Value
Fields.Description: The minimum value for the slider. Unused by other edit types.

Fields.Name: Slider: Maximum Value
Fields.Description: The maximum value for the slider.

Fields.Name: X: Target Type
Fields.Description: Param the X value is read from.

Fields.Name: X: Primitive Type
Fields.Description: Data type of the field read for X. Normally filled in automatically together with the Parameter Offset; do not edit by hand.

Fields.Name: X: Operation Type
Fields.Description: The operation to apply to the extracted parameter value.

Fields.Name: X: Parameter Offset
Fields.Description: Field read for X from the Target Type param, stored as the position just past the end of the field (field start plus the Primitive Type's size). Normally filled in automatically; do not edit by hand.

Fields.Name: X: Constant 0
Fields.Description: First constant used by the X Operation Type to adjust the extracted value.

Fields.Name: X: Constant 1
Fields.Description: Second constant used by the X Operation Type to adjust the extracted value.

Fields.Name: Y: Target Type
Fields.Description: Param the Y value is read from.

Fields.Name: Y: Primitive Type
Fields.Description: Data type of the field read for Y. Normally filled in automatically together with the Parameter Offset; do not edit by hand.

Fields.Name: Y: Operation Type
Fields.Description: The operation to apply to the extracted parameter value.

Fields.Name: Y: Parameter Offset
Fields.Description: Field read for Y from the Target Type param, stored as the position just past the end of the field (field start plus the Primitive Type's size). Normally filled in automatically; do not edit by hand.

Fields.Name: Y: Constant 0
Fields.Description: First constant used by the Y Operation Type to adjust the extracted value.

Fields.Name: Y: Constant 1
Fields.Description: Second constant used by the Y Operation Type to adjust the extracted value.
